title: personalVisitLog
description: Schema for a document in the 'personalVisitLog' collection. Records a personal outreach event created by a volunteer.

uid.description: The Firebase Auth UID of the volunteer who created this log.

dateTime.description: The date and time of the outreach event. Represents a Firestore Timestamp.

description.description: Free-text description of the outreach activity.

numberPeopleHelped.description: Number of people helped during the visit.

street.description: Street address of the outreach location.

stateAbbv.description: Two-letter state abbreviation of the outreach location.

zipcode.description: ZIP code of the outreach location.

Location.description: GPS coordinates of the outreach location.

rating.description: Volunteer's self-reported rating of the visit.

public.description: Whether this log is publicly visible.

isFlagged.description: Whether this log has been flagged for review.

flaggedByUser.description: UID of the user who flagged this log, if applicable.

approved.description: Whether this log has been approved.

status.description: Approval status. Valid options: pending, approved, rejected.
